purpose: Controller/mechanism factor attribution under a declared deterministic joint family; development only
prior: uniform over exact behavior classes, not over syntactic aliases
guards: Neither hidden delivered commands nor fault labels enter AgentWorldView
Issued command compliance is not verified treatment delivery
Freeze all candidate predictions before dispatch
Project attribution over every surviving factor, never only a representative
Public policy, factor compilation and evidence replay precede private reads
Private runtime executes controller and mechanism separately from compiled IR
Preserve all ambiguous, unresolved and failed cases
Same prior, horizon, costs and maximum budget for both planners
expected_boundary: Absent alternate actuation, unchanged mechanism with primary drop can be behaviorally identical to removed activation with healthy controller
analysis: Report mechanism and controller resolution separately; correct behavior identification does not imply unique factor attribution
exclusions: No independent structural holdout: seeds randomize names of fixed families
No stochastic faults or noise inference
Reset explicitly includes hidden controller state
No learned control model: candidates are supplied
Baseline is supplied reference knowledge, not newly validated in this run
No actual rule mutation within a run
No generated replacement structure or shadow validation
No Minecraft, natural RGB or overall completion claim
